segments.contextAfter: `customPixelFormat`: A dictionary containing a set of keys and values as described in [`CVPixelFormatDescription`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreVideo/CVPixelFormatDescription) suitable for providing as the ‘description’ parameter to [`CVPixelFormatDescriptionCreateWithPixelFormatType(_:_:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreVideo/CVPixelFormatDescriptionCreateWithPixelFormatType(_:_:)).  This must contain the custom pixel format fourCC as the value for the `kCVPixelFormatCodecType` key.
